_comment: Deployment channels the Axle plugin can point at, and the contract each one is pinned to. THIS FILE IS THE CLIENT'S HALF OF THE CASCADE GUARD: 'contractDigest' is the tool surface this client was built against. scripts/autopatch.js compares it to the digest the deployed hub reports at /version, so a core change that has not reached this manifest fails a check instead of failing a tool call in someone's editor. The pipeline updates the pin for a channel only after that channel's deploy has been smoke-tested.

local.description: A hub on your own machine (npm run dev:hub). Plaintext is allowed here and nowhere else.

dev.description: Shared development channel. Redeployed on every push to main; the pin here is allowed to lag.

prerelease.description: The App Service staging slot. What production is about to become — this is where a contract change is proven against a real client before promotion.

production.description: The production slot. Its pin is only ever advanced by CD, after a slot swap has passed its post-swap smoke test.
